title: D15.md step 2's privacy gate over the bundle refuses its own null-control bundle, so every D15 run stops at M2
claim: export.violations over the debug bundle, the scope D15.md M2 names, returns 72 violations on the synthetic dbg_bundle_gen.py bundle (no private datum by construction) and 1102 on the owner's real download with 0 true private hits, while over the sealed replay half (the scope tools/replay/debug_ingest.py stage 2 gates) both return 0.
mechanism: replay_doc.text_ok is the allowlist for a committed public replay fixture; the debug bundle's other sections carry text the integration itself writes (release strings in every cycle row, Home Assistant's redaction marker, insight and ledger prose that the ADDRESS regex reads as 'a word, then a house number', month keys). D15.md M2 and debug_ingest.py hold two definitions of the gate's scope; under the brief's, 'either failing stops the run' fires on every bundle including the null control (round 10 left M2 unfinished on it, item C1). The marker refusal is a second seam: _no_credential does not accept '**REDACTED**', so each redacted credential key reads as 'a credential-named key carries a value' (61 marker leaves refused in the real download).

evidence.value: synthetic_violations=72 (scope whole), real_violations=1102, real_private_hits=0, replay-half 0/0, leak_probe_controls_green=46/46, planted arms caught 5/5 per bundle
evidence.machine: macOS arm64, box B8 (shared), CI venv python3
evidence.tolerance: synthetic +-5 (prose varies with the fixture); real exact for this download

perturbation.change: --scope replay: the gate reads debug.replay only, as debug_ingest.py stage 2 does

null_control.note: a bundle with no private datum: every violation it raises is a false refusal

metric_definition: Strings export.violations returns over the scope named, per bundle; private_hits = credential-named keys holding anything but the redaction marker, or coordinates past the decimal cap.
phenomenon_property: D15's privacy gate passes a bundle that carries no private datum (the synthetic null control, and a real download whose only credential-key values are the redaction marker) and refuses a planted credential in any section.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D15/s1/privacy_gate.py --scope whole|debug|replay (each scope whose synthetic_violations exceeds 0 is a seam)
proposed_fix_scope: D15.md step 2 names the gate debug_ingest.py already runs (export.violations over debug.replay, planted-credential arm) plus a credential-key and coordinate rule over the rest of the download that accepts Home Assistant's redaction marker; a policy edit, owner approval before merge. No production change is required for the gate itself.
